protocol.scales: none: 1; std: sqrt(v); variance: v; damped: sqrt(v+0.01)
protocol.loss: half the averaged training squared loss
protocol.risk: excess squared prediction error without 1/2; test noise excluded
protocol.intercept: known fixed zero in population-centered coordinates
protocol.preprocessing: known population means/scales used unchanged for training and test
protocol.noise: iid Gaussian per fixed observation, reused on every draw
protocol.tuning_objective: oracle mean exact conditional rare-presence risk at each budget, separately per design/signal/method/scaling
protocol.tie_rule: first minimum in increasing rate grid
protocol.invalid_rule: nonfinite or covariance below -1e-8*max(1,max(abs(second))) => infinite tuning objective, retained record
protocol.unstable_rule: homogeneous second-moment radius >= 1 reported; finite-horizon finite outcomes remain eligible
protocol.uncertainty: MCSE across training-noise datasets, conditional on fixed design and selected rates; sampled-index and test-support moments integrated exactly
protocol.covariance: finite-replication mixture plug-in using denominator R, decomposed into conditional sampling covariance and covariance of conditional means across noise
protocol.pairing: same realized noisy datasets for all signals/scalings/methods within each design and stage; risk differences paired across noise seeds
protocol.scope: fixed count designs, fixed data replacement, final constant-step iterates; no fresh-data SGD or validation-based tuning
protocol.grid_summary: equal weight on all 24 design/signal cases; average paired conditional risks within each noise replication before computing MCSE
